name: α-methylmethcathinone
summary: α-Methylmethcathinone (α-Me-MC), also known as βk-mephentermine or as RAD-081, is a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) of the amphetamine, cathinone, and phentermine families. It is the α-methyl analogue of methcathinone and the β-keto analogue of mephentermine.
